name: OE Progress Board
public_summary: One public page showing where every Open English agent stands.

stages.note: The page is live and rebuilds itself every hour.

features_built: Shows one card per unit with a seven-stage stepper
Rebuilds itself every hour from each unit's own report
Marks a report older than 14 days as Stale
Rejects any report that contains private information
Publishes a unit's progress with one skill
features_pending: Cards for the eleven other agents and packs
A guide for backfilling each unit's history
A public README explaining the page
